note: Original practice material aligned with B2 First word formation and collocation skills; not official exam questions. Relations are sense-dependent, not interchangeable in every context.

antonymPairs.note: 视角相反：borrow something from someone；lend something to someone。
继续或停止活动；注意 stop doing 与 stop to do 不同。
比赛中获胜或失利；win a match，beat an opponent。
资源是否可用，或某人是否有空。
外观评价，表达时注意礼貌。
价格高低；cheap 有时也暗示质量差。
深度，或比喻性的思考程度。
就业状态，不等于当前是否忙碌。
此处 fair 表示公平，不是肤色或天气。
速度，fast 也可直接作副词。
friendly 是形容词，不是副词。
此处 mean 是形容词，非动词“意味着”。
一般质量评价；well 作副词，good 作形容词。
高度、水平；highly 不等于位置上的 high。
诚实与否，否定前缀为 dis-。
否定前缀为 il-，不是 un-。
否定形式注意双 n 的拼写。
新旧；年龄义项需结合语境。
此处 patient 是形容词，不是“病人”。
经济条件；其他义项需要语境。
待人感受方面；sensitive 不等于 sensible。
身体或力量；其他义项需要语境。
信息真假；true 的词族是 truth/truly。
useful 不等于 usable，useless 不等于 unused。
宽度；wide 的名词是 width。
年龄义项，与新旧义项分开。
此处比较重量；light 还有明亮等义项，不是每个义项都与 heavy 相反。

accept.exampleEnglish: I accepted their invitation to dinner.
accept.exampleChinese: 我接受了他们共进晚餐的邀请。
usageNotes: accept 是动词，acceptable 是形容词；acceptance 是名词。不要混淆 accept 与 except（除……之外）。

agree.exampleEnglish: We agreed to meet outside the library.
agree.exampleChinese: 我们同意在图书馆外面见面。
usageNotes: agree with 后接人或意见；agree on 后接共同决定的事项；agree to do 后接行动。

allow.exampleEnglish: The teacher allowed us to use a dictionary.
allow.exampleChinese: 老师允许我们使用词典。
usageNotes: allow someone to do；被动形式为 be allowed to do，不用 allow someone do。

appear.exampleEnglish: A message appeared on the screen.
appear.exampleChinese: 屏幕上出现了一条消息。
usageNotes: appear 作“出现”时通常不及物，不说 was appeared。

apply.exampleEnglish: She applied for a job at the museum.
apply.exampleChinese: 她申请了博物馆的一份工作。
usageNotes: apply for 后接所申请的职位或事物；apply to 后接机构；apply something to 表示应用。

avoid.exampleEnglish: Try to avoid making the same mistake again.
avoid.exampleChinese: 尽量避免再犯同样的错误。
usageNotes: avoid 后接动名词，不接 to do。

become.exampleEnglish: The town has become much quieter.
become.exampleChinese: 这个小镇已经变得安静多了。
usageNotes: become–became–become；has become 中使用过去分词，后接形容词时不用副词。

begin.exampleEnglish: The lesson began at nine o'clock.
usageNotes: begin–began–begun；have begun 不用 have began。

borrow.exampleEnglish: Could I borrow your pen for a moment?
borrow.exampleChinese: 我可以借用一下你的钢笔吗？
usageNotes: borrow 是借入，lend 是借出；lend someone something 或 lend something to someone。
break–broke–broken；has broken 和 was broken 都用过去分词，结构和含义不同。

bring.exampleEnglish: Please bring your notebook to the meeting.
bring.exampleChinese: 请把你的笔记本带到会议上。
usageNotes: bring–brought–brought；bring 强调带到说话者或指定目的地，take 常强调带走。

choose.exampleEnglish: We chose to travel by train.
usageNotes: choose–chose–chosen；choice 是名词，make a choice 是常见搭配。

consider.exampleEnglish: We are considering moving to a smaller flat.
consider.exampleChinese: 我们正在考虑搬到小一点的公寓。
usageNotes: consider 后接动名词；considerate（体贴的）与 considerable（相当大的）含义不同。
take something into consideration：把某事考虑在内。
continuous 强调不间断；continual 常指反复发生，不能在所有语境中互换。

create.exampleEnglish: The project will create new jobs.
create.exampleChinese: 这个项目将创造新的就业机会。
usageNotes: create → creation / creative / creativity；Part 3 需要依据空格所需词性选择。

decide.exampleEnglish: We decided to stay at home because of the rain.
decide.exampleChinese: 由于下雨，我们决定待在家里。
usageNotes: decide to do；decide on 后接选择的事物。decision 是名词，decisive 是形容词。
make a decision：作出决定。

depend.exampleEnglish: The result depends on how much you practise.
depend.exampleChinese: 结果取决于你练习多少。
usageNotes: depend on，不用 depend of；independent of 与 dependent on 的介词不同。

develop.exampleEnglish: She developed an interest in photography.
develop.exampleChinese: 她逐渐对摄影产生了兴趣。
usageNotes: development 是名词；developed 与 developing 表示不同的发展状态。

enjoy.exampleEnglish: I enjoy reading on the train.
usageNotes: enjoy 后接动名词，不接 to do；enjoyable 表示令人愉快的。

explain.exampleEnglish: Could you explain the rule to me?
explain.exampleChinese: 你能向我解释这条规则吗？
usageNotes: explain something to someone，不说 explain someone something。
give an explanation：作出解释。

feel.exampleEnglish: I felt much better after a short rest.
feel.exampleChinese: 短暂休息后，我感觉好多了。
usageNotes: feel–felt–felt；feel tired 用形容词。feel like 后接名词或动名词。

find.exampleEnglish: I found it difficult to concentrate in the noisy room.
find.exampleChinese: 我发现在吵闹的房间里很难集中注意力。
usageNotes: find–found–found。found（创办）是另一动词，其过去式与过去分词为 founded。

finish.exampleEnglish: Have you finished writing your report?
usageNotes: finish 后接动名词，不接 to do。

forget.exampleEnglish: I forgot to bring my umbrella.
usageNotes: forget–forgot–forgotten；forget to do 与 forget doing 的时间关系不同。

get.exampleEnglish: We got home just before it started to rain.
get.exampleChinese: 我们刚到家就开始下雨了。
usageNotes: get–got–got（英式常用）；gotten 常见于美式的某些义项。get used to 后接名词或动名词。

give.exampleEnglish: She gave me some useful advice.
give.exampleChinese: 她给了我一些有用的建议。
usageNotes: give–gave–given；advice 不可数，不用 an advice；give up 后可接动名词。

go.exampleEnglish: We went to the station on foot.
usageNotes: go–went–gone；has gone to 表示去了尚未回来，has been to 表示曾经去过。

help.exampleEnglish: This guide will help you understand the rules.
help.exampleChinese: 这份指南将帮助你理解规则。
usageNotes: help someone (to) do 两种形式均可；helpful 与 helpless 含义不同。

hope.exampleEnglish: I hope to visit Scotland next year.
usageNotes: hope to do 或 hope that；不用 hope someone to do。
including 是介词形式；included 常放在名词之后，如 breakfast included。

increase.exampleEnglish: The number of visitors has increased this year.
usageNotes: increase by 表示增加的幅度；increase to 表示增加后的总量。

know.exampleEnglish: I have known her for ten years.
usageNotes: know–knew–known；表示认识持续到现在时常用 have known，不用 have been knowing。
have a good knowledge of：对……有丰富知识。

learn.exampleEnglish: She learnt to drive last year.
usageNotes: learn–learnt/learned–learnt/learned；两种拼写均可，英式常用 learnt。

lend.exampleEnglish: Could you lend me your dictionary?
lend.exampleChinese: 你能把你的词典借给我吗？
usageNotes: lend–lent–lent；lend 表示借出，与 borrow 的方向不同。
躺：lie–lay–lain；说谎：lie–lied–lied；放置：lay–laid–laid。三者不能混用。

look.exampleEnglish: I am looking forward to seeing you again.
usageNotes: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词，不用 to see。
make someone do；被动形式为 be made to do。make 与 do 的搭配不能机械互换。

manage.exampleEnglish: We managed to catch the last bus.
manage.exampleChinese: 我们设法赶上了末班公交车。
usageNotes: manage to do 表示最终成功做到；management 是名词，manager 指管理者。

mean.exampleEnglish: This job means working at weekends.
mean.exampleChinese: 这份工作意味着周末也要工作。
usageNotes: mean–meant–meant；mean doing 与 mean to do 含义不同。

need.exampleEnglish: You need to book your ticket in advance.
usageNotes: need doing 常表示某物需要被处理，如 The room needs cleaning；不等于主动的 need to do。

offer.exampleEnglish: She offered to help me with my homework.
offer.exampleChinese: 她主动提出帮我做作业。
usageNotes: offer to do；offer someone something 或 offer something to someone。

prefer.exampleEnglish: I prefer walking to driving for short journeys.
prefer.exampleChinese: 短途出行时，比起开车我更喜欢步行。
usageNotes: prefer A to B；would prefer to do；would rather do，结构不要混用。

prevent.exampleEnglish: The heavy rain prevented us from leaving.
usageNotes: prevent someone from doing；from 后使用动名词。

provide.exampleEnglish: The hotel provides guests with breakfast.
usageNotes: provide someone with something；provide something for someone，介词和宾语位置不同。

read.exampleEnglish: I have read that book twice.
read.exampleChinese: 那本书我已经读过两遍了。
usageNotes: read–read–read 拼写相同；原形读 /riːd/，过去式和过去分词读 /red/。

recommend.exampleEnglish: I recommend booking your tickets early.
usageNotes: recommend doing 或 recommend that someone (should) do；不用 recommend someone do 作为通用模板。

remember.exampleEnglish: Remember to lock the door before you leave.
usageNotes: remember to do 指尚待完成的动作；remember doing 指回想过去经历。

require.exampleEnglish: The job requires good communication skills.
require.exampleChinese: 这份工作要求良好的沟通能力。
usageNotes: required 表示被要求的或必需的；requirement 是名词。
meet a requirement：满足要求。

rise.exampleEnglish: Prices have risen sharply this year.
usageNotes: rise–rose–risen，不及物；raise–raised–raised，及物，如 raise the price。

say.exampleEnglish: She said that she would call later.
usageNotes: say–said–said；say something to someone，而 tell someone something。

see.exampleEnglish: Have you seen my keys anywhere?
see.exampleChinese: 你在哪儿看见我的钥匙了吗？
usageNotes: see–saw–seen；see someone do 常关注完整动作，doing 常关注正在进行的动作。

suggest.exampleEnglish: He suggested taking an earlier train.
suggest.exampleChinese: 他建议乘坐更早的一班火车。
usageNotes: suggest doing 或 suggest that someone (should) do；不用 suggest someone to do。
make a suggestion：提出建议。

take.exampleEnglish: It took us an hour to reach the airport.
take.exampleChinese: 我们花了一个小时才到机场。
usageNotes: take–took–taken；It takes someone time to do 是常见结构。

tell.exampleEnglish: She told me to wait by the entrance.
usageNotes: tell–told–told；tell 后通常有人作宾语；say 与 tell 的结构不同。

try.exampleEnglish: I tried restarting the computer, but it did not help.
try.exampleChinese: 我试着重启了电脑，但没有用。
usageNotes: try to do 强调努力；try doing 强调尝试一种解决办法。

used.exampleEnglish: I used to cycle to school every day.
used.exampleChinese: 我过去每天骑自行车上学。
usageNotes: used to do 与 be/get used to doing 不同；后者的 to 是介词。

write.exampleEnglish: The report was written by a local journalist.
write.exampleChinese: 这篇报道是一位本地记者写的。
usageNotes: write–wrote–written；被动语态 be written 和完成时 have written 都使用过去分词。

available.exampleEnglish: Are you available for a short meeting tomorrow?
available.exampleChinese: 你明天有空开个短会吗？
usageNotes: available 是形容词；availability 是名词；unavailable 表示无法获得或没空。

aware.exampleEnglish: Are you aware of the changes to the timetable?
aware.exampleChinese: 你知道时刻表的变化吗？
usageNotes: aware of 或 aware that；awareness 是名词，unaware 是否定形式。
raise awareness of：提高对……的认识。

careful.exampleEnglish: Be careful when you cross the road.

collocations.english: be careful not to do something

usageNotes: careful → carefully；careless → carelessly。注意不能仅根据词尾就判断褒贬。

confident.exampleEnglish: She felt confident about the interview.
confident.exampleChinese: 她对这次面试很有信心。
usageNotes: confident 是形容词，confidence 是名词，confidently 是副词。
have confidence in someone：对某人有信心。

different.exampleEnglish: Your answer is different from mine.
usageNotes: different → difference / differently；英式学习中可优先掌握 different from。
make a difference：产生影响。

wordFormation.prompt: There is a clear ___ between the two plans.
wordFormation.chinese: 这两个计划之间存在明显差别。
wordFormation.explanation: a clear 后需要可数名词单数；different 是形容词，difference 是名词。

excited.exampleEnglish: The children were excited about the trip.
excited.exampleChinese: 孩子们对这次旅行感到兴奋。
usageNotes: excited 描述感受，exciting 描述使人兴奋的事物；不要只按“人/物”机械判断。

familiar.exampleEnglish: I am familiar with this type of software.
usageNotes: 人 familiar with 事物；事物 familiar to 人，注意视角变化。

friendly.exampleEnglish: The staff were very friendly and helpful.
friendly.exampleChinese: 工作人员很友好，也很乐于助人。
usageNotes: friendly 是形容词。表示友好地可用 in a friendly way，不用 friendlily 作为常用表达。

good.exampleEnglish: She is very good at explaining difficult ideas.
good.exampleChinese: 她很擅长解释复杂的概念。
usageNotes: good–better–best；good 是形容词，well 常作副词，不能将 goodly 当作对应副词。

happy.exampleEnglish: I am happy with the progress we have made.
happy.exampleChinese: 我对我们取得的进展感到满意。
usageNotes: happy–happier–happiest；happiness 与 happily 都将 y 变为 i 后加后缀。

interested.exampleEnglish: I am interested in learning more about photography.
interested.exampleChinese: 我有兴趣进一步学习摄影。
usageNotes: interested 描述感受；interesting 描述引起兴趣的特征；介词 in 后接动名词。
take an interest in：对……产生兴趣。

likely.exampleEnglish: It is likely to rain later.

collocations.english: be more likely to do something

usageNotes: likely 在此为形容词；likelihood 是名词；unlikely 是否定形式。
be unlikely to do something：不大可能做某事。

necessary.exampleEnglish: It is necessary to book in advance.
usageNotes: necessary → necessity / necessarily / unnecessary；注意 c、s 和双 n 的拼写。

possible.exampleEnglish: Would it be possible to change the date?
usageNotes: possible → possibility / possibly / impossible；impossible 的否定前缀是 im-。

responsible.exampleEnglish: She is responsible for organizing the event.
usageNotes: responsible → responsibility / responsibly / irresponsible；for 后接动名词。
take responsibility for：承担……的责任。

similar.exampleEnglish: The two designs are similar to each other.
usageNotes: similar to，不用 similar with；similarity 是名词，similarly 是副词。
succeed → success → successful → successfully；success + ful 构成 successful，后缀 -ful 只有一个 l；successfully 中 -ly 接在 successful 后。

suitable.exampleEnglish: This course is suitable for beginners.
usageNotes: suit 是动词，suitable 是形容词；否定形式为 unsuitable。

tired.exampleEnglish: I was too tired to cook after work.
tired.exampleChinese: 下班后我太累了，不想做饭。

collocations.english: be too tired to do something

usageNotes: tired 描述疲倦的感受；tiring 描述使人疲倦的活动；tired of 常表示厌倦。
本词条主要义项为名词“熊”。另一个动词义“承受、承担”用 bear–bore–borne；be born 表示出生，不与“熊”的名词义混用。
found（创办）→ founded → founded；find（找到）→ found → found，是两个不同的动词。
悬挂通常用 hang–hung–hung；hanged 常用于“绞死”义项。
lay–laid–laid 表示放置，通常需要宾语；lie–lay–lain 表示躺。
high 可表示位置高；highly 常表示程度高，如 highly successful，不能在所有语境中互换。
hard 同形作形容词或副词；hardly 表示“几乎不”，不是 hard 的普通副词形式。
late 表示晚或迟；lately 表示最近，二者不等同。
near 表示接近；nearly 表示几乎，不能机械地把 -ly 形式作为同义替换。
invaluable 表示极其宝贵，并不是 valuable 的反义词；valueless 表示无价值。
sensitive 表示敏感或体谅的；sensible 表示明智的。两者不能混淆。
considerate 表示体贴的；considerable 表示相当大的，两个形容词不能互换。
imaginary 表示虚构的；imaginative 表示有想象力的。
stop doing 表示停止正在做的事；stop to do 表示停下原来的事去做另一件事。
little 表示数量少时用 less / least；表示体积小时常改用 small / smaller / smallest。littler / littlest 存在但不宜作为所有语境的默认替换。
本词条的常见名词义是“病人”；patient 另可作“有耐心的”形容词，patience / patiently / impatient 属于这个形容词义的词族。
fast 可以直接作形容词或副词，如 a fast train / run fast；不把 fastly 作为常用副词形式。
形容词 light 表示轻时，比较级为 lighter，最高级为 lightest；light 另有“光”和“点燃”等义项，注意不要混入其他词性的形式。

exercises.prompt: It was a difficult ___ to make.
exercises.chinese: 这是一个很难作出的决定。
exercises.explanation: a difficult 后接名词；decide 的名词形式为 decision。

exercises.prompt: There were over fifty ___ in the race.
exercises.chinese: 比赛中有五十多名参赛者。
exercises.explanation: fifty 后需要表示人的复数名词；competitor 要加 s。

exercises.prompt: Her face was full of ___.
exercises.chinese: 她的脸上洋溢着幸福。
exercises.explanation: of 后需要名词；happy 变 y 为 i，再加 -ness。

exercises.prompt: Swimming helps to build physical ___.
exercises.chinese: 游泳有助于增强体力。
exercises.explanation: 此处需要名词；strong → strength，不是直接加 -ness。

exercises.prompt: What is the ___ of the swimming pool?
exercises.chinese: 这个游泳池有多长？
exercises.explanation: the 后和 of 前需要名词；long → length，词干内部发生变化。

exercises.prompt: We measured the ___ of the room.
exercises.chinese: 我们测量了房间的宽度。
exercises.explanation: 需要表示宽度的名词；wide → width。

exercises.prompt: Please tell me the ___.
exercises.chinese: 请告诉我真相。
exercises.explanation: the 后需要名词；true → truth。

exercises.prompt: The team completed the project ___.
exercises.chinese: 团队成功地完成了项目。
exercises.explanation: 修饰 completed 需要副词；success → successful → successfully。

exercises.prompt: It was ___ to see anything in the dark.
exercises.chinese: 黑暗中什么也看不见。
exercises.explanation: 根据 in the dark 判断否定含义；possible 的否定形式为 impossible。

exercises.prompt: He accepted full ___ for the mistake.
exercises.chinese: 他为这个错误承担了全部责任。
exercises.explanation: full 后需要名词；responsible → responsibility。

exercises.prompt: Please read the instructions ___.
exercises.chinese: 请仔细阅读说明。
exercises.explanation: 修饰 read 需要副词 carefully，不是形容词 careful。

exercises.prompt: Driving too fast can be ___.
exercises.chinese: 开车太快可能很危险。
exercises.explanation: be 后需要形容词；danger → dangerous。

exercises.prompt: The staff made us feel welcome with their ___ manner.
exercises.chinese: 工作人员以友好的态度让我们感到受欢迎。
exercises.explanation: 修饰 manner 需要形容词；friendly 虽以 -ly 结尾，仍是形容词。

exercises.prompt: Please check the ___ of rooms before booking.
exercises.chinese: 预订前请查看是否有空房。
exercises.explanation: the 后需要名词；available → availability。

exercises.prompt: She spoke ___ during the interview.
exercises.chinese: 她在面试时自信地发言。
exercises.explanation: 修饰 spoke 需要副词；confident → confidently。

exercises.prompt: The course encourages ___ thinking.
exercises.chinese: 这门课程鼓励创造性思维。
exercises.explanation: 修饰 thinking 需要形容词 creative；creativity 是名词。

exercises.prompt: There is a clear ___ between the two plans.
exercises.chinese: 这两个计划之间存在明显差别。
exercises.explanation: a clear 后需要可数名词单数；different 是形容词，difference 是名词。

exercises.prompt: Could you give me a clear ___?
exercises.chinese: 你能给我一个清楚的解释吗？
exercises.explanation: a clear 后需要名词；explain → explanation，注意拼写变化。

exercises.prompt: It is ___ to park here without a permit.
exercises.chinese: 没有许可证在这里停车是违法的。
exercises.explanation: without a permit 提示否定含义；legal → illegal，前缀为 il-。

exercises.prompt: Thank you for waiting so ___.
exercises.chinese: 谢谢你如此耐心地等待。
exercises.explanation: 修饰 waiting 需要副词 patiently；patience 是名词。

exercises.prompt: He ___ asked us to move our bags.
exercises.chinese: 他礼貌地请我们挪开行李。
exercises.explanation: 修饰 asked 需要副词 politely。

exercises.prompt: Since we decided to walk, booking a taxi was ___.
exercises.chinese: 既然我们决定步行，订出租车就没有必要了。
exercises.explanation: 此处用否定形容词 unnecessary；注意前缀 un- 与 necessary 相接时的双 n。

exercises.prompt: We need a ___ source of information.
exercises.chinese: 我们需要一个可靠的信息来源。
exercises.explanation: 修饰 source 需要形容词；rely → reliable，y 发生变化。

exercises.prompt: Please drive ___ in the rain.
exercises.chinese: 雨天请安全驾驶。
exercises.explanation: 修饰动词 drive 需要副词 safely；keep something safe 则需要形容词，结构不同。

exercises.prompt: The map was very ___ when we got lost.
exercises.chinese: 我们迷路时，这张地图很有用。
exercises.explanation: very 后需要形容词 useful；-ful 只有一个 l。

exercises.prompt: The seats were surprisingly ___.
exercises.chinese: 这些座位出乎意料地舒适。
exercises.explanation: were 后需要形容词 comfortable；comfort 是名词或动词。

exercises.prompt: Good ___ is essential before an interview.
exercises.chinese: 面试前做好准备很重要。
exercises.explanation: 此处需要主语名词；prepare → preparation。

exercises.prompt: Wear a helmet for your own ___.
exercises.chinese: 为了保护自己，请戴上头盔。
exercises.explanation: your own 后需要名词；protect → protection。

exercises.prompt: The team carried out a ___ experiment.
exercises.chinese: 团队进行了一项科学实验。
exercises.explanation: 修饰 experiment 需要形容词 scientific。

exercises.prompt: It was very ___ of her to offer us a lift.
exercises.chinese: 她主动提出开车送我们，真是体贴。
exercises.explanation: 描述体贴用 considerate；considerable 表示相当大的。

exercises.prompt: The story is set in an ___ country.
exercises.chinese: 这个故事发生在一个虚构的国家。
exercises.explanation: 虚构的国家用 imaginary；imaginative 表示富有想象力的。

exercises.prompt: The lecture was much more ___ than I expected.
exercises.chinese: 这场讲座比我预料的有趣得多。
exercises.explanation: 讲座具有引发兴趣的特征，用 interesting；interested 通常描述感兴趣的状态。
